definition: to cross a river where it is shallow
description: In green hill country on a sunny day, a pale green off-road vehicle drives straight through a shallow stony river towards the viewer, throwing up big splashes, while a smiling young man leans out of a side window. Beside it a line of flat stepping stones runs across the river, where sheep stand waiting, and an older walker stands on the dirt track on the far bank. A wooden marker post stands in the water and a green rubber boot lies on the stones.

taps.phrase: to wait on the stepping stones
to watch from the far bank
